originalSourceText:
Q.3  What does the "Back EMF" generated by a rotating DC motor do and

       is given by which equation? (where 𝑣 = voltage; 𝑘𝑚, 𝑘𝑒 = motor
      constant; 𝑖𝑎 = armature current; 𝑟𝑎 = armature resistance;  𝜃̇𝑚=
      angular velocity; 𝑙𝑎 = armature inductance)
     A) it adds to the applied voltage; 𝑣 = 𝑘𝑚· 𝑖𝑎
     B) it opposes the applied voltage; 𝑣= 𝑘𝑒. 𝜃̇𝑚
     C) it amplifies torque; 𝑣= 𝑟𝑎. 𝑖𝑎
     D) it has no effect on the circuit; 𝑣= 𝑙𝑎. 𝑖𝑎
     Answer: B

     Refer to Lecture 22: Modeling and Control of a Single Joint Slide 6
